engine_binary_baseline: No engine/service change since 2.5.10: all 2.5.11 commits are GUI-only (crates/findx2-gui-native) plus a CI serial-test tweak. No index-format migration (v6 generations unchanged; wal/ directory additive). Official GitHub Release artifacts are produced by the existing release.yml CI rebuild on tag v2.5.11 (Windows native only); they are not byte-identical to any local build.
limitations: installer live handoff not re-run for 2.5.11 (in-app update path changed to /SILENT + process wait; first live-matrix run happens on user machines, rollback semantics unchanged and covered by exit-80 unit/source-scan regressions)
in-app update progress verified by unit + source-scan regressions and build only; no new-version round-trip executed locally (would replace the installed product)
macOS and Linux native GUI packages do not exist yet
Official CI packages are a new rebuild and are not byte-identical to any local build
